text:
Sam: Alert from vuln-scan: found `vault:v2:` ciphertext inside a container image layer pushed to gcr.io/redwood-staging/build-cache:2026-03-21. Could be previous build output baked into an image.
Priya: That image was produced by the nightly builder. Which layer path?
Sam: Path inside image: `/var/lib/build-cache/step-output/logs/credentials.tar.gz` (layer id sha256:abc123). The file contains base64 blob `vault:v2:ABCD...` looks like transit-wrapped material.
Omar: If creds landed in image layers then anyone pulling that image could have grabbed ciphertext and attempted decrypts. Check KMS logs for Decrypt activity.
Nina: Running a KMS audit query now: `resource.type="k8s_cluster" protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"` and filtering time window around image push.
DevSecBot: Created incident INC-2026-0999 (severity: high) and opened task card "container-layer-wrapped-creds".
Sam: Immediate containment: 1) mark gcr image unreachable (set vulnerability embargo and remove tag), 2) block the builder SA from pulling images, 3) snapshot affected image for forensics.
Priya: I'm untagging the image and adding `deny` in Artifact Registry IAM for `serviceAccount:builder-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Will also set a bucket lifecycle to prevent layers from being public.
Omar: Long term actions: rotate any staging secrets that may have been encrypted with the old wrapping key, rotate the KMS wrap key, and run a Vault rewrap of objects in Vault and any stored artifacts. We should assume ciphertext may have been exfiltrated.
Nina: KMS logs show 42 decrypt attempts in last 48h from `serviceAccount:external-ci@partner-org.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. 6 succeeded, but those map to pre-rotation rewrap attempts by our vault-proxy prior to key ACL changes. Need to cross-check the principals.
Sam: Plan: A) create new KMS key `wrap-v2-rot` and update Vault transit to use it in a staged swap, B) restrict the old KMS key to `vault-proxy` and `secops` group only, C) rotate staging DB creds and all staging secrets with TTL <= 30d immediately, D) rewrap persisted ciphertext server-side.
Priya: I'll own IAM & Artifact Registry lockdown. I'll open PR for the IAM delta and request an emergency approval.
Omar: I'll run the Vault rewrap job. Using server-side `vault write transit/rewrap` so plaintext never leaves Vault. I'll test on extracted layer samples first.
Nina: I'll push an audit sink to sec-bq with filter for `protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" OR resourceName: "projects/redwood-staging/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*"` so we can pivot by principal and object name.
Sam: Also add an alert: >50 decrypts from same principal in 24h -> pager. Lower threshold for partner principals.
DevSecBot: Noted. Added alert rule draft and linked to INC-2026-0999.
Priya: Question: for rotating staging DB creds, do we use the automated rotation job or do a force rotate? Staging can tolerate downtime for a 15m window.
Omar: Force rotate with immediate credential replacement. I'll coordinate with app owners to restart workloads.
Sam: Don't forget to update the CI build templates to remove `tar` of build outputs into image layers and pipe logs to GCS only. Add a pre-publish scan to detect `vault:` headers in image filesystem.
Nina: Good call. I'll author a container-scanner rule in infra repo that inspects image layers for `vault:v[0-9]+:` patterns and fail the build.
Priya: IAM change applied to remove Artifact Registry pull permission from `external-ci@partner-org`. :lock:
Omar: Rewrap test successful on sample layers, no plaintext returned. Starting batch rewrap of Vault objects at +1h. Throttling to 20 ops/s.
Sam: Filing partner outreach note in the incident doc in case the principal is third-party. Legal to review before outreach.
DevSecBot: Incident severity -> high, status -> containment. Added playbook link: docs/security/playbooks/container-secret-exposure.md
Sam: After containment, schedule a 7-day audit window to monitor for any new decrypt activity and run a scan across all Artifact Registry images for `vault:` artifacts.
Priya: PR for IAM lockdown is up for emergency review. Tagging @sec-approvers.
Nina: I'll add the container-scanner rule and a CI job to run `grep -R "vault:v[0-9]+:" /image` during build. Example command: `docker save $image | tar -xO | grep -a --text -E "vault:v[0-9]+:" || true`.
Omar: One more: update runbooks to include steps for sealing/unsealing Vault if we need to revoke transit keys quickly. I'll add a section.
Sam: Thanks all. Keep updates here and paste the final rotation artifact list into the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
